newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to stage international coffee fair in February 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to stage international coffee fair in February 1997.

text.p: Mexico will stage an international coffee fair called "Expo Cafe 1997" in February next year to promote improved coffee production, quality and trading opportunities, organisers said.

The fair, to be held in the coffee town of Huauchinango in the northern sierra of Puebla State, will run from February 15-23, with participants from Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Brazil and the United States.

"We want to promote good competition in all aspects of coffee production and trading," said fair coordinator Jose Manuel Toscana, adding that one aim of the fair is to push for more awareness of economical and ecologicial coffee production techniques.
The Puebla state government is supporting the event which has also received the backing of the Mexican Coffee Council, the national umbrella group for the industry.
